entities.name: Oketra's Monument
entities.description: A legendary pyramid and sacred site on Amonkhet dedicated to the god Oketra, host of the Trial of Solidarity.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: Vigilant cat-headed god who guards her city and sets the Trial of Solidarity.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: City at whose edge the monument stands.

entities.name: Luxa River
entities.description: River along whose banks the monument stands.

entities.name: Hekma
entities.description: The desert region beyond which Oketra watches.

entities.name: Trial of Solidarity
entities.description: Oketra's first test for initiates, in which they defend their obelisk and retrieve her arrow.

entities.name: The Ascent
entities.description: Yearly wheat-harvest rite honoring Oketra in which initiates climb with heavy burdens.

entities.name: Anointed
entities.description: Mummies that raise the obelisk and attack in the trial.

events.summary: Initiates perform the Ascent at the wheat harvest, climbing the exterior stairs with burdens to present offerings to Oketra.
events.quote: Each year, Oketra is honored through an ancient rite known as the Ascent , performed at the wheat harvest.

events.summary: In the Trial of Solidarity, Oketra looses a radiant arrow into the floor, the arena shifts, and waves of foes attack the initiates and their obelisk.
events.quote: Oketra appears on a balcony, drawing an arrow of radiant light from the orb crowning the pyramid.

events.summary: Initiates must split their efforts between retrieving the arrow and defending the obelisk to prove themselves worthy.
events.quote: Should the obelisk fall, the trial fails

relations.quote: a legendary artifact and sacred site on the plane of Amonkhet
dedicated to the vigilant cat-headed god Oketra
